specification.title: Tile plurality likelihood
specification.hypothesis: Fit class logits from a normal approximation to the probability of the observed tile winner.
specification.risk: Spatially correlated pixels violate independent count approximations.

specification.title: Cross-fitted supervision trust
specification.hypothesis: Refit appearance using original coarse pixels weighted by spatially held-out predictive support.
specification.risk: Rare correct appearances may be downweighted as if erroneous.

specification.title: Locally shrinking class appearance
specification.hypothesis: Let local class means vary while shrinking sparse observations to global means.
specification.risk: Local coarse errors may be reinforced.

specification.title: Pairwise class decisions
specification.hypothesis: Learn each class contrast separately and reconcile log pairwise win probabilities.
specification.risk: Inconsistent pairwise decisions can hurt multiclass calibration.

specification.title: Colour co-occurrence
specification.hypothesis: Classify RGB together with local covariance and lag-correlation features.
specification.risk: Texture scales may obscure small components.

specification.title: Sparse patch reconstruction
specification.hypothesis: Classify by the L1-penalized reconstruction energy in a class-specific orthogonal patch dictionary.
specification.risk: Weakly labelled mixed patches may produce poor dictionaries.

specification.title: Low-rank structure and sparse residual
specification.hypothesis: Project probability patches onto a low-rank basis and retain large residual exceptions.
specification.risk: Small true components may be mistaken for noise; this is a one-step approximation, not converged robust PCA.

specification.title: Wavelet probability field
specification.hypothesis: Shrink small Haar detail coefficients instead of spatially blurring the mask.
specification.risk: Grid-phase sensitivity and removal of real fine structure.

specification.title: Minimum-description spatial partition
specification.hypothesis: Choose homogeneous spatial cells by global fit-versus-complexity dynamic programming.
specification.risk: Axis-aligned cells can introduce geometric artefacts.

specification.title: Semi-Markov tissue runs
specification.hypothesis: Use dynamic programming over labelled runs along image axes.
specification.risk: Directional bias or loss of thin components.

specification.title: Continuous spline probability field
specification.hypothesis: Fit class evidence using a compact cubic spline field with coarse-only supervision.
specification.risk: Insufficient basis detail or excessive spatial bias.

specification.title: Higher-order class motifs
specification.hypothesis: Learn soft triad likelihoods from known coarse class configurations.
specification.risk: Coarse tile geometry may contaminate context statistics.

specification.title: Expected macro-IoU decision
specification.hypothesis: Choose a coupled hard assignment using posterior expected intersection/union.
specification.risk: Miscalibrated probabilities can overexpand rare classes.

specification.title: Interval palette evidence
specification.hypothesis: Use feasible class-probability bounds to expose ambiguous RGB interpretations.
specification.risk: Bounds may be too loose to change decisions, while adding cost.

specification.title: Colour copula likelihood
specification.hypothesis: Estimate non-Gaussian class marginals separately from their rank dependence.
specification.risk: Sparse class observations can destabilize tail estimates.

specification.title: Training-tile influence
specification.hypothesis: Penalize predictions whose class score is sensitive to deleting individual training tiles.
specification.risk: Rare but valid regions may depend on a few tiles.

specification.title: Converged palette active set
specification.hypothesis: Solve the palette quadratic to checked KKT tolerance instead of a fixed iteration count.
specification.risk: More accurate optimization need not improve biological segmentation.

specification.title: Adaptive colour precision
specification.hypothesis: Refine colour cells only where a decision-error bound cannot certify their winner.
specification.risk: Conservative bounds can erase the speed advantage.

specification.title: Adaptive spatial resolution
specification.hypothesis: Use fine sampling wherever within-cell RGB variation can change a class decision.
specification.risk: Subdivision overhead can exceed dense linear classification.

specification.title: Exterior white-space geometry
specification.hypothesis: Remove border-connected bright low-saturation white space while preserving enclosed lumina.
specification.risk: Border-connected adipose or lumen can be removed incorrectly.

specification.title: Two-component palette explanation
specification.hypothesis: Minimize palette reconstruction error plus the original quadratic prior on every simplex edge; choose the globally best pair, so at most two class fractions are nonzero.
specification.risk: A third genuine tissue at a junction may be suppressed together with false third-class colour bands.

specification.title: H&E-conditioned palette inference
specification.hypothesis: Use a coarse-trained shared-covariance model of fixed RGB and aligned original H&E optical densities as the prior in the palette quadratic; solve each pixel without RGB-only quantization.
specification.risk: Original stain variation or mixed coarse supervision may introduce false microscopic structures.

specification.title: Relative-entropy palette inverse
specification.hypothesis: Minimize half squared palette residual plus 0.012 KL(q || coarse-trained colour prior), subject to the probability simplex, with feasible damped Newton iterations.
specification.risk: An overconfident coarse colour prior can resist a valid tissue change even with accurate numerical optimization.

specification.title: Robust palette residual
specification.hypothesis: Minimize the sum of channelwise Huber residuals with transition 0.04 plus the original quadratic prior; solve the iteratively reweighted simplex quadratics.
specification.risk: A real class-specific colour coordinate may be mistaken for an aberrant reconstruction channel.

specification.title: Regularize only invisible mixtures
specification.hypothesis: Minimize half squared palette residual plus 0.006 times squared projection of q-prior onto the nullspace of the augmented palette; apply a numerical 1e-9 ridge only for stability.
specification.risk: RGB noise can make identifiable mixture fractions unstable when the palette is nearly dependent.

specification.title: Directional palette geometry
specification.hypothesis: Normalize observed RGB and every palette vector to unit Euclidean length, then solve the original simplex quadratic in directional colour geometry.
specification.risk: Classes separated mainly by brightness, especially grey debris versus other tissue, may become indistinguishable.

specification.title: Poisson tile-winner probability
specification.hypothesis: Approximate each tile's class counts by independent Poisson variables with means equal to summed pixel probabilities; maximize the exact count-order event probability, with deterministic class-index tie breaking.
specification.risk: Poisson independence and weak tile labels may remain inaccurate; summation is more expensive than the parent's normal approximation.

specification.title: Within-tile nuisance covariance
specification.hypothesis: Estimate class centroids from equally weighted known tile means and nuisance covariance from deviations around each tile mean; use the resulting shared-covariance pixel discriminant.
specification.risk: True tissue mixtures inside a coarse tile may be downweighted as nuisance variation.

specification.title: Information-volume tile design
specification.hypothesis: Keep the original normal tile-winner likelihood, but greedily select class-covered tile observations by log-determinant gain of standardized mean-colour design vectors, up to 12 bags per known class.
specification.risk: Geometrically extreme tiles may overrepresent noise or omit common mixed appearances.

specification.title: Local affine class appearance
specification.hypothesis: For each class and pixel, fit a spatially affine RGB prototype by compact-window weighted normal equations and global-prototype ridge; classify by shared-covariance residual.
specification.risk: Sparse local class observations can make an affine extrapolation less reliable than a constant local mean.

specification.title: Shared spatial colour nuisance
specification.hypothesis: Fit one quadratic spatial RGB drift to residuals from known class means, subtract this shared field, then fit and evaluate a single class discriminant.
specification.risk: A real large-scale tissue transition may be absorbed into the nuisance field.

specification.title: Competing glass observation model
specification.hypothesis: Learn each known tissue class's white-pixel rate from original H&E and coarse observations. Combine that Bernoulli likelihood with local class evidence and an explicit glass state of prior 0.08; assign zero only when glass wins.
specification.risk: Coarse mixtures can underestimate a genuine lumen's white rate; glass and adipocyte interiors remain locally photometrically ambiguous.

specification.title: Colour dependency tree
specification.hypothesis: Estimate smoothed one- and two-channel histograms per class, choose the maximum-mutual-information spanning tree of RGB channels, and evaluate its normalized joint density.
specification.risk: A tree cannot represent a genuine three-way colour interaction; sparse pair histograms may create artificial ridges.

specification.title: Hierarchical colour probability tree
specification.hypothesis: Partition all tissue RGB recursively by median splits of the widest colour coordinate; multiply class-conditional Beta(1,1) predictive branch probabilities to obtain leaf likelihoods.
specification.risk: Axis-aligned leaf boundaries can become false class interfaces and depth limits may erase rare colours.

specification.title: Density in discriminating colour plane
specification.hypothesis: Solve the between-class versus within-class generalized eigenproblem, project RGB onto its top two contrast directions, and classify using joint two-dimensional empirical class densities.
specification.risk: A rare class requiring the discarded third direction may be merged with another tissue.

specification.title: Uncertain local prototype
specification.hypothesis: Integrate Gaussian uncertainty in the local affine intercept: score RGB residual with covariance Sigma times (1 + 0.015 M_inverse[0,0]) and its log determinant.
specification.risk: Variance inflation can make unsupported class extrapolations too tolerant or penalize a genuinely rare local class.

specification.title: Leave-query-tile-out local fit
specification.hypothesis: Subtract the full query tile's clipped-window sufficient statistics before the local affine fit, using exact integral-image rectangle sums; retain the global coarse-trained shrinkage prior.
specification.risk: A small class represented in one tile loses its only local evidence and must fall back on a contaminated global prototype.

specification.title: Geometric white clefts
specification.hypothesis: Use the parent tissue likelihood, but assign a whole original-H&E white component to glass only if area >=20 um2, inertia length >=16 um, axis ratio >=4 and area/length <=10 um.
specification.risk: An elongated genuine gland lumen can be deleted; a broad round empty cavity will remain filled. Expert-labelled white tissue is still scored.

specification.title: Forward-blur palette inverse
specification.hypothesis: Minimize 0.5 ||B(q P)-RGB|| squared +0.006 ||q-prior|| squared on per-pixel simplexes, where B is a symmetric 2 um Gaussian point-spread operator; record projected-gradient residual.
specification.risk: The assumed blur can be wrong and amplify noise or create ringing; erased structure is not uniquely recoverable from RGB.

specification.title: Coarse-calibrated colour sensor
specification.hypothesis: Fit one identity-shrunk affine map from known palette vertices to coarse-trained class RGB means, with residual-map ridge 0.05; invert the resulting observed palette by the checked simplex quadratic.
specification.risk: Coarse mixtures can bias the sensor map and erase valid palette separation, especially with only a few observed classes.

specification.title: Simplicial colour manifold
specification.hypothesis: Project palette vertices to their intrinsic affine space, triangulate that space, and interpolate class coordinates in the containing simplex; outside the hull choose the nearest palette vertex.
specification.risk: An arbitrary tessellation can choose the wrong mixture branch and nearest-vertex extrapolation can make abrupt transitions outside the palette hull.

specification.title: Convex mean-logit tile evidence
specification.hypothesis: Fit ridge multinomial cross entropy to the mean pixel logit of each original known tile; solve the small convex problem by damped analytic Newton steps and report gradient residual.
specification.risk: A tile mean can hide small discriminating structures and does not encode the actual count-winner event.

specification.title: Representative-pixel tile evidence
specification.hypothesis: For each class pool pixel logits inside a tile by log-mean-exp, then maximize bag-label cross entropy with a single ridge-regularized model and analytic gradient.
specification.risk: One bright or unusual pixel can act as a spurious witness, overexpanding a class outside its true architecture.

specification.title: Kernel distribution regression
specification.hypothesis: Average 48 fixed Gaussian random Fourier colour features within each known tile; solve class-balanced ridge regression to tile labels, then evaluate the same learned function on each pixel.
specification.risk: A tile-distribution predictor need not be calibrated for a single pixel; weak labels can confound nonlinear colour contrasts.

specification.title: Local colour-increment covariance
specification.hypothesis: Keep equally weighted tile class centroids but estimate nuisance covariance as half the second moment of adjacent known within-tile RGB differences, with the parent's covariance shrinkage.
specification.risk: Correlated noise and genuine microscopic boundaries violate independent-increment assumptions; colour drifts may be treated as strong tissue evidence.

specification.title: Random-intercept tissue appearance
specification.hypothesis: For each class subtract pooled within-tile covariance/25 from the covariance of its tile means, project the signal covariance onto PSD matrices, and add pixel noise for a class-specific predictive Gaussian.
specification.risk: Few tiles make between-tile variability unstable; a broad class covariance may engulf small neighboring tissues.

specification.title: Joint all-rival margin contrasts
specification.hypothesis: Whiten tile means by pooled within-tile covariance and fit one ridge-regularized mean squared all-rival hinge objective; apply the learned linear discriminant to all pixels.
specification.risk: Ambiguous coarse tile means can force an inappropriate separating plane and suppress rare weakly represented tissue.

specification.title: Distributional colour energy
specification.hypothesis: For each weighted class colour measure score a query by half the expected within-class Euclidean colour distance minus expected query-to-class distance; compute potentials by 3D FFT convolution.
specification.risk: A broad or multimodal class can have a deceptively central energy minimum; subtle small-class modes may be lost.

specification.title: Polyhedral colour support
specification.hypothesis: Estimate each class's intrinsic RGB convex hull from known coarse colour samples; choose greatest signed distance to its supporting planes, minus any off-subspace residual; stream facet tests in C++ OpenMP.
specification.risk: A convex hull bridges genuine holes and modes, and coarse contamination can enlarge support around unrelated colours.

specification.title: Split-sample colour typicality
specification.hypothesis: Fit copula densities on one checkerboard half of coarse tiles, rank test log densities among held-out observations of each class, and classify by the largest empirical typicality value; report all-class tail regions separately.
specification.risk: A broad class can seem typical for many unrelated colours; weak labels and spatial dependence preclude formal conformal guarantees.

specification.title: Bounded local colour prediction
specification.hypothesis: Moment-match local affine mean and regression predictive variance to independent Beta channel densities on the RGB unit cube; classify by their normalized log density.
specification.risk: Channel independence and feasible Beta variance projection can exaggerate endpoint colours or lose cross-channel discrimination.

specification.title: Spatial Laplace regression
specification.hypothesis: Fit each class/channel's global spatial-affine RGB surface by sparse linear-program weighted absolute deviation plus L1 slopes, then use a normalized independent-channel Laplace observation model.
specification.risk: A single spatial surface cannot track genuine nonlinear appearance drift; coarse mixture medians can still be wrong.

specification.title: White-space clearance reconstruction
specification.hypothesis: Compute the physical Euclidean distance transform inside bright original-H&E components; reconstruct and remove entire 8-connected white components containing a disk of radius 4 um.
specification.risk: A large true gland lumen or adipocyte interior can also contain the required disk; fine reference-positive removals remain errors.

specification.title: Poisson palette observation
specification.hypothesis: Minimize sum of palette mean minus observed RGB times log palette mean, plus the coarse colour-prior quadratic, on the probability simplex using feasible accelerated projected gradients.
specification.risk: Synthetic conversion RGB is not a photon count; intensity-dependent observation curvature can distort low-valued channels.

specification.title: Conserved class-area projection
specification.hypothesis: Find the minimum KL change from the parent posterior subject to row sums one and global class totals equal to coarse-weighted known class proportions extrapolated across all detected tissue; solve the convex dual by Newton steps.
specification.risk: Coarse tile winners are not area fractions, and unannotated tissue may have different composition; the global totals can be incorrect.

specification.title: Ordinal palette observation
specification.hypothesis: Use three within-pixel RGB channel-order comparisons as logistic observations of the palette mixture, with the original coarse-colour quadratic prior; solve the convex simplex objective.
specification.risk: Only six strict RGB channel orders exist; classes with the same order become weakly identifiable and rely on the coarse prior.

specification.title: Correlated tile-count evidence
specification.hypothesis: Estimate an intrabag design effect from class-centred between-tile posterior-mean variation versus within-tile variation, then scale the pairwise normal count variance and fit its analytic-gradient composite likelihood.
specification.risk: Between-tile biological heterogeneity can be mistaken for pixel correlation; one fixed estimated design effect may be poorly calibrated.

specification.title: Exact categorical tile comparisons
specification.hypothesis: For every own/rival pair, convolve the independent per-pixel +1/0/-1 categorical count factors, sum the exact winner tail with deterministic ties, and obtain analytic probability derivatives by forward/backward convolution in C++ OpenMP.
specification.risk: Exact independent-pixel count tails still misrepresent correlated tissue; the product of pairwise probabilities is a composite likelihood, not the joint multiclass event.

specification.title: Pairwise ranking of tile colours
specification.hypothesis: For each known class minimize mean squared positive-versus-negative tile colour ranking error with a ridge; solve its pair-difference second-moment normal equation analytically and identify the intercept by the mean midpoint.
specification.risk: Ranking risk does not identify calibrated multiclass probabilities and mixed tile means can suppress true small structures.

specification.title: Angular nuisance scatter
specification.hypothesis: Estimate within-tile RGB residual shape by the trace-normalized regularized Tyler fixed point, combine it with one empirical radial scale, and apply the shared-covariance class discriminant.
specification.risk: Real class distinctions can depend on the radial excursions that this shape estimator downweights; finite fixed-point convergence is recorded.

specification.title: Pooled rank-normal colour geometry
specification.hypothesis: Estimate one pooled coarse-weighted empirical CDF per RGB channel, transform every tissue colour to marginal normal scores, then fit the within-tile shared-covariance discriminant in that geometry.
specification.risk: Pooled channel ranks can distort a class-specific contrast or amplify rare tails, especially where coarse sampling is biased.

specification.title: Matched neighbouring-tile contrasts
specification.hypothesis: Use adjacent unlike-label coarse tile pairs as matched colour-difference observations; solve the class-incidence normal equations for consistent class prototypes, with weak coarse-mean anchors for disconnected contrasts.
specification.risk: Boundary tiles may not represent class interiors, and local stain nuisance may not cancel between paired tiles.

specification.title: Local colour-distribution transport
specification.hypothesis: Compare each nine-point physical RGB neighbourhood with weighted class colour quantiles through seven fixed one-dimensional projections; assign by mean squared quantile transport distance.
specification.risk: Finite projections and a small patch can miss true multivariate structure; a mixed coarse class has a contaminated target distribution.

specification.title: Full-tissue modal colour basins
specification.hypothesis: Estimate one density on all detected tissue RGB, follow deterministic 26-neighbour ascent to colour modes, and fit each basin's Dirichlet class counts only from original known coarse tissue; expose unsupported modes as unknown-identity proposals.
specification.risk: Different tissues may share one colour mode; unsupported basins have no semantic evidence and equal prior counts give an arbitrary lowest-ID hard tie.

specification.title: Joint maximum-entropy colour density
specification.hypothesis: Fit a normalized exponential-family RGB density per class using all 26 nonconstant tensor degree-two Legendre moments and a convex ridge dual; normalize by fixed midpoint cubature on the RGB cube.
specification.risk: Low-order moments can erase rare modes and finite cubature approximates the continuous normalizer; unsuccessful optimization remains explicit.

specification.title: Spatial latent appearance states
specification.hypothesis: Fit two shared-covariance Gaussian appearances per known coarse class by finite EM, then infer their local mixture probabilities from original coarse-weighted responsibilities in a48um window; evaluate log mixture evidence in C++ OpenMP.
specification.risk: A mixed coarse class can create a false appearance mode, and finite EM can reach a poor local optimum.

specification.title: Screened harmonic appearance field
specification.hypothesis: Minimize coarse-weighted RGB prototype residuals plus16um squared-gradient energy and0.015 global-mean anchoring on an8um field grid; solve sparse positive-definite equations and classify by the fitted class appearances.
specification.risk: A smooth global field can erase abrupt genuine appearance drift and interpolate an inappropriate coarse class.

specification.title: Interface-conditioned white cavities
specification.hypothesis: Keep the parent tissue probabilities but remove a bright original-H&E component only when area is at least32um2 and its2um external ring supports two classes with at least0.25 mean posterior each.
specification.risk: True lumina at class interfaces and uncertain rings can still be deleted; positive reference removals remain scored errors.

specification.title: Coarse-supervised blind palette fitting
specification.hypothesis: Alternate checked simplex mixture optima and bounded palette least squares for one anchored biconvex objective, using at most4096 original known coarse points; freeze the learned palette before whole-tissue inference.
specification.risk: Coarse mixture contamination can bias the palette, and alternating minimization is not a globally identified solution.

specification.title: Brightness and offset nuisance planes
specification.hypothesis: For each class profile squared RGB residual over a nonnegative gain and neutral offset with0.01 identity ridge; use the resulting class energy and unchanged confidence-dependent coarse correction.
specification.risk: Class planes can overlap and absorb real discriminating intensity differences as nuisance.

specification.title: Nonlinear cardinal palette coordinates
specification.hypothesis: Fit constant-reproducing Gaussian radial interpolants at unique palette vertices with median squared-distance bandwidth and1e-7 ridge; project interpolated coordinates to the simplex and split duplicate vertices equally.
specification.risk: Smooth nonlinear interpolation may assign the wrong fractions to genuinely mixed conversion colours or overshoot between vertices.

specification.title: Minimal plural support sets
specification.hypothesis: Pool each tile/class over its highest ceil(25/K) pixel logits, then fit one ridge bag-label likelihood with deterministic support-set ties and analytic gradients.
specification.risk: The necessary minimum winning count does not specify the true plurality event and can reward spurious support subsets.

specification.title: Explicit coarse observation channel
specification.hypothesis: Estimate a row-stochastic coarse-label channel from palette fractions of original known tile means, shrink it halfway to identity, and fit bag-mean probability likelihood through that fixed channel.
specification.risk: Palette fractions may not identify the real coarse-label error mechanism, and forward correction can suppress valid rare tissues.

specification.title: Information-volume tile likelihood
specification.hypothesis: Fit mean-tile multinomial likelihood with minus half the log determinant of the ridged Fisher information, a fixed reference-class gauge and analytic determinant gradients; report finite-budget stationarity.
specification.risk: The information correction can distort weak tile evidence and the numerical information ridge breaks exact Jeffreys invariance.

specification.title: Noise-marginalized exponential discrimination
specification.hypothesis: Whiten original tile means by within-tile covariance and minimize the all-rival exponential loss analytically integrated over Gaussian mean error of covariance I/25, plus one quadratic coefficient penalty.
specification.risk: Spatial correlation invalidates the Gaussian mean-error approximation and exponential risk can amplify wrong coarse labels.

specification.title: Whole-tissue prevalence inference
specification.hypothesis: Keep original coarse-trained class densities fixed and maximize the full-tissue RGB mixture likelihood over class proportions with a weak symmetric Dirichlet term; apply those proportions as posterior class priors.
specification.risk: Label shift fails when unannotated tissue has different appearance, potentially collapsing a rare real class.

specification.title: Robust tile-centroid location
specification.hypothesis: In within-tile whitened RGB coordinates, estimate each known class centre by the convex smoothed geometric-median objective with1e-4 norm smoothing, then use the shared nuisance metric for pixel discrimination.
specification.risk: A minority valid appearance can be treated as contamination and downweighted along with erroneous coarse tiles.

specification.title: RGB dependence trees
specification.hypothesis: Estimate positive class RGB histograms, choose the maximum-mutual-information spanning tree of the three channel variables, and use its exactly normalized discrete conditional-density product.
specification.risk: A two-edge dependence graph cannot represent three-way interactions and coarse contamination can choose misleading channel links.

specification.title: Adaptive neighbour colour density
specification.hypothesis: Represent weighted original coarse colours by at most2048 deterministic quantile samples per class, estimate local density from eight-neighbour ball volumes at occupied RGB nodes, and report all-class radius outliers with unknown identity.
specification.risk: Repeated colours, finite sampling and a one-level RGB radius floor can overconcentrate densities or miss rare modes.

specification.title: Positive Bernstein RGB density
specification.hypothesis: Fit positive weights of64 normalized tensor cubic Bernstein/Beta densities by finite EM on original coarse-weighted colour nodes, with a weak symmetric Dirichlet term and explicit likelihood history.
specification.risk: A low-order continuous density can erase rare sharp modes and finite EM may not meet its stopping tolerance.

specification.title: H&E edge-conducted appearance
specification.hypothesis: On the parent's 8um grid, weight each physical appearance-field edge by 0.02+exp(-squared H&E optical-density contrast/(2*0.1^2)); retain the 16um screened field and original shared RGB covariance.
specification.risk: Stain and microscopic cell edges can prevent legitimate borrowing of class appearance across the field.

specification.title: Joint shared colour-drift field
specification.hypothesis: Jointly fit one constant RGB mean per original class and one shared 8um spatial RGB drift field by a single screened sparse block normal system, with 0.015 anchors and 16um physical regularity.
specification.risk: A common drift cannot represent genuinely independent local changes in different tissue classes.

specification.title: Harmonic exterior-glass access
specification.hypothesis: On a 4um H&E grid solve the harmonic probability of reaching exterior bright seeds before stained tissue seeds, using OD edge conductance; remove only bright analysis pixels with glass probability above0.95.
specification.risk: Border adipose can act as a false glass seed; absent two-sided seed evidence must yield no extra deletion.

specification.title: Integrated palette dominance
specification.hypothesis: Integrate dominant-class probability under exp(-(RGB residual squared+0.012 prior deviation squared)/(2*0.025^2)) using cyclically symmetrized128-point fixed-seed scrambled Sobol Dirichlet0.3 importance quadrature per class.
specification.risk: Finite importance quadrature can miss narrow or high-dimensional posterior modes and distort class dominance.

specification.title: Colour-graph coupled inverse
specification.hypothesis: Add 0.0075 sum(q*Lq) to the original palette energy on a symmetric six-neighbour occupied-colour graph, and run100 projected steps with a checked spectral step bound and explicit residual.
specification.risk: Different tissues can occupy neighbouring converted colours, so colour-graph coupling can erase genuine semantic interfaces.

specification.title: Coarse tile log-fraction decoder
specification.hypothesis: Use mean log fractions of25 original known tile samples as observations, fit an identity-centred multinomial decoder with0.01 ridge, and apply the decoder to the unchanged palette posterior at every pixel.
specification.risk: Coarse winner contamination can teach the decoder to undo correct palette mixtures or suppress minority classes.

specification.title: Gaussian-integrated hinge risk
specification.hypothesis: For every own/rival contrast, minimize E[max(0,1+delta dot noisy tile mean)^2] with Gaussian covariance I/25 in whitened RGB and0.0025 coefficient ridge; evaluate the expectation and gradient analytically.
specification.risk: The lower-growth hinge risk may underfit genuinely difficult original tile observations while retaining the Gaussian noise approximation.

specification.title: Noise-deconvolved class scatter
specification.hypothesis: Subtract I/25 from within-class covariance of whitened tile means, project to PSD, shrink by n/(n+5) toward pooled latent scatter, add pixel noise I, and classify with class-specific normalized Gaussian quadratic scores.
specification.risk: Sparse coarse tiles may not identify class scatter, and the assumed mean measurement error can remove real biological variance.

specification.title: Additive nonlinear colour risk
specification.hypothesis: Fit linear plus four softplus knots per whitened RGB coordinate by27-point Gaussian-Hermite exponential-risk cubature and0.0025 ridge, optimizing a monotone log of the positive convex objective for numerical stability.
specification.risk: An additive response cannot represent genuine colour interactions; finite cubature and occupied-colour representatives are approximate.

specification.title: Rigid latent palette calibration
specification.hypothesis: Alternate checked simplex fractions with an identity-anchored proper Procrustes rotation and translation of the canonical palette for12 steps, preserving every pairwise vertex distance exactly.
specification.risk: A rigid palette cannot explain nonrigid conversion distortion, and latent vertices may lie outside the display RGB cube.

specification.title: Tile-winner constrained palette
specification.hypothesis: Fit endmembers to original tile means with latent simplex fractions constrained q[observed winner]>=q[rival], using star-order projection and finite accelerated quadratics inside12 bounded palette updates.
specification.risk: A winner among true pixel counts is not necessarily the largest mean converted-colour fraction; finite inner solves can retain residual error.

specification.title: Calibration-uncertain palette risk
specification.hypothesis: After the parent's bounded palette fit, estimate interior endmember covariance sigma^2*(Q^T W Q+0.02 I)^-1; add three times this matrix to the prediction quadratic Hessian, giving expected RGB reconstruction risk.
specification.risk: An interior Gaussian approximation ignores active palette box constraints and may overmix weakly identified classes.

specification.title: Shared-count Gaussian winner
specification.hypothesis: Approximate class counts by independent Gaussians and integrate the product of all rival count CDFs conditional on one own count using21 Gaussian-Hermite points, with analytic probability and logit gradients.
specification.risk: Independent Gaussian counts omit multinomial anticorrelation, and finite quadrature may poorly resolve sharply concentrated count events.

specification.title: Latent corrupted tile observations
specification.hypothesis: Normalize all pairwise-normal composite winner masses across classes, mix with uniform contamination epsilon=0.49*sigmoid(eta), and jointly fit eta and class logits with a0.02 log clean-observation prior.
specification.risk: A global contamination fraction cannot distinguish true weak-label errors from an inadequate colour model.

specification.title: Learned nonlinear colour votes
specification.hypothesis: Fit linear logits plus an eight-unit learned tanh residual to the original normal-count composite likelihood, starting from the original colour discriminant and using finite60-step CPU L-BFGS with explicit parameter ridges.
specification.risk: Nonconvex coarse-only learning can fit spurious colour islands and may not converge within the subsecond preference.

specification.title: Orientation-guided appearance
specification.hypothesis: Use a symmetric eight-neighbour physical graph weighted by the H&E structure tensor: borrow along tissue orientation more freely than across it; fit the same screened appearance fields.
specification.risk: Cell orientations can be irrelevant to tissue boundaries and can propagate the wrong colour along a bundle.

specification.title: Covariance-coupled vector field
specification.hypothesis: Fit vector appearance with Mahalanobis data/prior error but isotropic RGB graph energy; diagonalize the covariance and solve one sparse normal system per colour eigenmode.
specification.risk: A pooled noise covariance may over-smooth a rare discriminating colour direction.

specification.title: Log-normal appearance field
specification.hypothesis: Fit H&E-conducted appearance fields to log((255 RGB+1)/256), estimate the pooled log-colour covariance, and classify with conditional log-normal likelihood.
specification.risk: Near-zero synthetic channels become disproportionately influential; converted colours are not physical stain intensities.

specification.title: Fused appearance field
specification.hypothesis: Minimize weighted squared data error plus a smooth vector total-variation graph penalty and the global-mean anchor; use finite majorizing quadratic solves and report the original objective/residual.
specification.risk: Piecewise-constant appearance can introduce false plateaux or suppress gradual real changes.

specification.title: Bending appearance field
specification.hypothesis: Replace the Laplace Dirichlet energy by squared physical-Laplacian energy, solving L-transpose L plus observed mass and the same global anchor.
specification.risk: Curvature regularity can overshoot across genuine abrupt appearance changes and increase sparse-solve cost.

specification.title: Positive quasi-Poisson field
specification.hypothesis: Fit positive RGB means by Poisson quasi-deviance with spatial quadratic regularity and a positive global-mean anchor; use positivity-preserving damped Newton and classify by the same deviance.
specification.risk: Synthetic RGB channels are not counts; the mean-variance relation can be wrong and Newton solves may exceed the time budget.

specification.title: Worst-channel palette inverse
specification.hypothesis: Minimize 0.025 times maximum absolute channel reconstruction error plus 0.006 squared distance to the original colour prior on the simplex; report a primal-dual gap from a C++ independent-row solver.
specification.risk: Protecting the worst channel can let small errors in several reliable channels accumulate; finite gaps may remain.

specification.title: Heteroscedastic palette inverse
specification.hypothesis: Estimate each input tile covariance from all its converted colours, shrink and normalize its inverse to trace three, then solve the palette simplex quadratic in that local Mahalanobis geometry.
specification.risk: Real tissue mixtures can be mistaken for noise and tile-specific metrics can produce grid artifacts.

specification.title: Colour-cloud harmonic coordinates
specification.hypothesis: Join occupied colour cells and canonical palette vertices in a symmetric six-neighbour colour graph; pin vertices to their semantic unit vectors and solve screened harmonic coordinates with the original colour prior.
specification.risk: Colour-cloud bottlenecks can connect unrelated tissue classes; coarse-prior screening can dominate far from palette vertices.

specification.title: Worst-case colour margin
specification.hypothesis: Fit squared hinge risk for the worst mean-colour perturbation in a whitened radius-0.2 ball: margin is 1+delta dot x+0.2 norm(delta_colour), plus the original ridge.
specification.risk: Protecting against adversarial colours can underfit small but genuine class differences.

specification.title: Quadratic Gaussian Brier risk
specification.hypothesis: Predict one-hot class scores with all degree-at-most-two whitened colour monomials; analytically integrate their Gaussian Brier risk using moments through degree four, then solve the class-balanced ridge normal equations.
specification.risk: Quadratic scores can extrapolate implausibly and Brier regression need not match a tile plurality event.

specification.title: Joint Gaussian logistic risk
specification.hypothesis: Integrate multiclass log-softmax cross entropy over shared three-dimensional Gaussian tile-mean errors using 27 fixed Gauss-Hermite points, with the original ridge and finite optimizer budget.
specification.risk: Finite cubature can miss tail behaviour and probabilistic tile-mean labels can still hide rare pixel classes.

specification.title: Empirical tile-noise risk
specification.hypothesis: Replace the Gaussian moment-generating function by the empirical mean of exponentials over the 25 within-tile centred residuals divided by five; retain class-balanced all-rival risk and ridge.
specification.risk: The sampled residual law may not represent correlated tile-mean noise and outliers can dominate exponential risk.

specification.title: Worst-class exponential risk
specification.hypothesis: Minimize the maximum class-conditional log Gaussian exponential risk plus coefficient ridge, using a single convex epigraph problem with analytic constraint Jacobians.
specification.risk: A severely contaminated or scarcely observed class can dictate every decision and hurt the average.

specification.title: Shared low-rank contrasts
specification.hypothesis: Add 0.02 times the nuclear norm of the class-by-three colour coefficient matrix to the original Gaussian exponential risk; use singular-value proximal steps with monotone backtracking and report the mapping residual.
specification.risk: A rare class may require the suppressed third contrast direction; finite proximal iterations can remain unconverged.

specification.title: Nonlocal H&E appearance
specification.hypothesis: Replace four-neighbour transport by a symmetric six-neighbour graph in H&E optical density plus coordinates/128; use inverse physical-distance conductance and the same class-mass screened field.
specification.risk: Distant regions can share stain but not tissue identity; appearance may leak across unrelated islands.

specification.title: Uncertain appearance prediction
specification.hypothesis: Use the same H&E-conducted class mean field, but add 0.015 times the screened inverse-system diagonal to predictive variance, estimating that diagonal with sixteen fixed Rademacher probes; include the Gaussian volume penalty.
specification.risk: A pseudo-observation noise model and finite diagonal probes may misstate uncertainty and penalize a rare class far from its observations.

specification.title: Wide-path exterior glass
specification.hypothesis: Keep parent tissue decisions exactly; remove bright H&E pixels reconstructed from exterior-connected white cores with distance-to-stain at least3 coordinate units, restoring a3-unit rim only inside white.
specification.risk: Border fat can contain a wide exterior path; legitimate reference-positive white removals remain errors, and internal detached cavities remain filled.

specification.title: Bounded bending appearance
specification.hypothesis: Minimize the parent quadratic bending energy subject to every fitted RGB channel remaining in[0,1], using a finite box-constrained optimization and reporting its projected gradient.
specification.risk: True class appearance near a bound may flatten, and an iterative constrained solve may exceed the one-second preference.

specification.title: Robust bending observations
specification.hypothesis: Fit whitened RGB appearance by radial Huber data loss with radius2.5, a quadratic global anchor and the same squared-Laplacian prior; use eight majorizing solves and the same radial likelihood for classification.
specification.risk: A rare valid mode may look like coarse-label contamination; finite IRLS can retain a material stationarity residual.

specification.title: Local covariance appearance
specification.hypothesis: Fit class-specific first and second RGB moments with the bending operator; derive local covariance, shrink it twenty percent to the shared covariance, clip eigenvalues below0.0025 and include its log determinant in Gaussian decisions.
specification.risk: Weak labels may not identify local second moments; PSD projection can create overconfident covariance islands.

specification.title: Hellinger palette observation
specification.hypothesis: Minimize one half sum((sqrt(qP+1/255)-sqrt(RGB+1/255))^2) plus0.006 squared prior distance on the simplex, with monotone projected-gradient backtracking and explicit mapping residual.
specification.risk: Dark synthetic channels receive more influence even when they are biologically uninformative; finite convergence may remain.

specification.title: Heavy-tailed palette error
specification.hypothesis: Minimize0.00125*log(1+palette-residual-squared/0.0025) plus0.006 squared prior distance, using twelve majorizing simplex quadratics and reporting the original nonconvex objective path.
specification.risk: Large true palette discrepancies can be discounted as outliers; initialization can select a poor local minimum.

specification.title: Minimum-entropy mixtures
specification.hypothesis: Add -0.002 sum((q+1e-5)*log(q+1e-5)) to the original simplex quadratic; solve twelve tangent-majorized convex simplex quadratics and record the original nonconvex energy and terminal change.
specification.risk: A genuinely mixed boundary may be forced toward a pure class and the finite majorization solution is only local.

specification.title: Joint rival hinge
specification.hypothesis: Minimize Gaussian-integrated squared maximum-rival margin violation using27 fixed Gaussian-Hermite nodes, class-balanced tile means and0.0025 coefficient ridge.
specification.risk: Only the strongest rival contributes locally, potentially neglecting a second rare class; finite quadrature and optimizer stopping remain approximate.

specification.title: Tile-specific uncertainty
specification.hypothesis: For each original25-point bag use its whitened residual covariance/25 in the exact Gaussian expected squared hinge, rather than common I/25; retain the same class-balanced risk and ridge.
specification.risk: Tissue mixtures can be misread as noise and25-point independence can still understate spatial correlation.

specification.title: Kernel class distributions
specification.hypothesis: Embed each class distribution of whitened tile means in a Gaussian kernel of squared bandwidth3; analytically average reference-tile Gaussian noise I/25 and assign by squared kernel-mean distance at occupied colour nodes.
specification.risk: A class with several modes can have a diffuse embedding and the chosen kernel may merge fine colour distinctions.

specification.title: Difficult-tile protection
specification.hypothesis: Minimize smooth upper-quarter CVaR of per-tile empirical log exponential rival risk, with softplus temperature0.05 and the original0.0025 coefficient ridge; jointly optimize the tail threshold.
specification.risk: Incorrect coarse labels can dominate the protected tail and sacrifice common valid tissue.

specification.title: Correlated block noise
specification.hypothesis: Replace25 independent residuals divided by five with the ten centred row/column means of the original5x5 bag divided by sqrt(5); retain the empirical exponential-risk classifier.
specification.risk: Row/column blocking can miss diagonal correlations and the available tile grid may not identify true effective sample size.

specification.title: Equal tile log risk
specification.hypothesis: Minimize the class-balanced average of log(1+mean over empirical residuals and summed rivals exp(rival-own)), plus0.0025 coefficient ridge, with an analytic gradient.
specification.risk: Reducing between-tile exponential tilting can underemphasize a genuinely difficult rare appearance.

specification.title: Latent true-class fields
specification.hypothesis: At each field node retain separate weighted RGB means for each observed coarse class. Infer its latent true class with observation channel P(observed|true)=0.8 I+0.2/K; alternate eight exact screened-field M steps and Gaussian responsibilities, keeping the original global class anchors.
specification.risk: A wrong initial prototype can relabel valid observations and reinforce an incorrect field; finite EM gives a local, aggregated-observation solution.

specification.title: Conserved observed appearance
specification.hypothesis: Solve the parent quadratic field with one additional equality per channel: mass^T fitted=mass.sum()*original_class_mean. Use the exact rank-one Schur correction A^-1 mass and report both normal-equation and equality residuals.
specification.risk: A contaminated global mean is preserved exactly and may force an unrepresentative shift into a poorly observed region.

specification.title: Series-resistance stain transport
specification.hypothesis: Sample original H&E optical density along each field edge; compute local conductances from optical-density increments scaled by the number of path intervals. Replace endpoint conductance by their harmonic mean, the electrical series law, with the same physical length and floor.
specification.risk: Nuclear stain fluctuations can become barriers even within one true tissue compartment; fine edges can isolate legitimate observations.

specification.title: Positive sampling uncertainty
specification.hypothesis: Propagate independent observation noise through the screened estimator: v=0.015 diag(A^-1 diag(mass) A^-T). Estimate it by the mean square of sixteen weighted Rademacher solves, sharing one factorization with the mean fit; use Gaussian predictive variance 1+v.
specification.risk: The assumed independent node noise is not calibrated from expert labels and finite probes retain sampling error.

specification.title: Student predictive appearance
specification.hypothesis: Keep the parent mean and inverse-system diagonal. Integrate an inverse-gamma noise scale using nu=3+effective original coarse-tile count per class; use the normalized three-dimensional Student density including its gamma normalizers and predictive scale factor.
specification.risk: Weak tiles are not independent, so the degrees of freedom may be optimistic; a heavy tail can preserve a false colour island.

specification.title: Expected appearance distance
specification.hypothesis: With the parent prototype variance v, minimize exact expected squared Mahalanobis distance E[D]=MahalanobisDistance+3v. The fitted mean and uncertainty estimator are unchanged; softmax only normalizes negative decision risks.
specification.risk: The parent approximate diagonal is not calibrated, and penalizing prototype variance can suppress a genuinely rare, weakly observed class.

specification.title: Free-boundary thin plate
specification.hypothesis: Replace the squared Neumann graph Laplacian by 16^4 times Dxx^T Dxx+2Dxy^T Dxy+Dyy^T Dyy, using only valid second-difference stencils and physical spacing. Affine colour planes have exactly zero bending cost.
specification.risk: A free affine nullspace can extrapolate colour drift beyond observed tissue; the small global anchor remains necessary.

specification.title: Hermite appearance observations
specification.hypothesis: Add quarter-weight squared errors between neighbouring fitted RGB increments and observed class-mean RGB increments, only when both field nodes lie in the same original coarse tile. Retain the parent bending prior and global anchor.
specification.risk: Gradients reuse the same measurements and can encode tissue mixtures as appearance drift; this is a Hermite fitting energy, not an independent-data likelihood.

specification.title: Noncollapsing class appearance
specification.hypothesis: In whitened RGB fit all class fields jointly with the parent quadratic energy plus 0.015 sum over nodes and class pairs exp(-||u_g-u_h||^2/2). Use up to80 sparse quadratic majorization steps with a0.015*K curvature bound and report the original energy and gradient.
specification.risk: Repulsion can invent separation between genuinely overlapping appearances and the nonconvex solve may be slow or stop before stationarity.

specification.title: Accumulated-stain glass access
specification.hypothesis: Keep J01 tissue decisions and replace the glass rule by eight-neighbour shortest paths on a four-coordinate-unit H&E grid from white border pixels, integrating positive mean optical density above0.03, divided by0.1 and path length3. Remove only original white pixels with total cost at most1.
specification.risk: Long weakly stained routes can be blocked while border fat can still look like glass; optical density here is only a geometric access cost.

specification.title: Visible exterior glass
specification.hypothesis: Keep J01 tissue decisions and remove white pixels only when an uninterrupted horizontal, vertical or diagonal white ray reaches the image edge. Evaluate eight exact lattice directions without resampling.
specification.risk: Curved genuine exterior clefts can remain filled, while straight white paths into border fat can be removed.

specification.title: Glass energy cut
specification.hypothesis: On a four-coordinate-unit grid minimize H&E glass Bernoulli unary cost plus2 times physical interface length by exact integer-capacity s-t maxflow. Force stained pixels to tissue and white border pixels to glass; upsample the cut and remove only original white pixels.
specification.risk: A bright internal lumen can be classified as glass without exterior access; integer capacities and grid resolution approximate the stated continuous energy.

specification.title: Quantization-aware palette
specification.hypothesis: At occupied colour nodes minimize half the squared distance of qP to each observed byte interval RGB plus or minus0.5/255, plus0.006 squared prior distance, on the simplex. Report monotonic objective and projected-gradient residual.
specification.risk: A half-byte interval cannot explain larger conversion errors and occupied-node averaging is an approximation absent from the affine parent branch.

specification.title: Counterfactual class necessity
specification.hypothesis: Measure the least squared RGB error over the full palette hull and each hull with one class removed, using a1e-7 numerical tie ridge. Rank classes by the nonnegative increase in reconstruction error when that class is forbidden, with the original coarse prior breaking equal scores.
specification.risk: A palette vertex inside the hull of its rivals is never necessary; necessity is not a calibrated tissue probability and quantized nodes can hide small colours.

specification.title: Robust palette calibration
specification.hypothesis: Minimize half (||qP-RGB||_2+0.03||q||_2)^2 plus0.006 squared prior distance on the simplex; this is the exact worst-case residual for a shared palette perturbation of Frobenius norm at most0.03. Use up to600 ADMM steps, exact simplex quadratics and the exact two-norm prox; start rho0.1 and balance primal/dual residuals every20 steps by factors of two at ratio10. Report primal, dual and Lagrangian stationarity residuals.
specification.risk: The uncertainty radius is fixed rather than empirically calibrated and robustness can overmix a real rare class; finite optimization remains.

specification.title: Integral tile observations
specification.hypothesis: Replace pointwise class-node observations by one weighted RGB average per original coarse tile and class. B averages field nodes with original pixel weights; solve (L+B.T W B+0.015I)u=B.T W tileRGB+0.015 globalMean. W preserves total parent observation mass.
specification.risk: Tile averages discard within-tile architectural detail and the nonlocal normal equations can extrapolate appearance incorrectly.

specification.title: Shared multiplicative sensor
specification.hypothesis: Fit one spatial scalar gain a from RGB=a(s) globalClassMean using the original coarse observations, H&E conductance and a unit-gain quadratic anchor. Solve one positive screened system; score all classes using a(s) times their global mean and the original shared covariance.
specification.risk: A common scalar sensor cannot describe class-specific or chromatic drift and may underfit real tissue appearance.

specification.title: Exact anatomical tree competition
specification.hypothesis: On a four-coordinate-unit spatial grid aggregate parent negative-log scores as area-weighted unaries. Build an H&E optical-density minimum spanning tree and minimize unary plus six times edge length times exp(-ODcontrastSquared/0.02) Potts cost by exact tree dynamic programming. Project categorical cells by nearest neighbour.
specification.risk: A spanning tree drops image cycles and the coarse grid can produce block edges or join unrelated tissue through one retained edge.

specification.title: Coherent tile noise
specification.hypothesis: Keep the mean fit; assign a shared Rademacher perturbation to all field nodes in the same original tile. Propagate sixteen block-noise probes through each class system and use their mean squared solutions as positive predictive variance.
specification.risk: A tile-wide systematic error model may overstate correlation and broaden weakly supported classes.

specification.title: Common-noise class contrasts
specification.hypothesis: Use common field-node noise probes across class fits, estimate positive marginal variances and pairwise covariances, and compare class squared-distance scores with a first-order Gaussian contrast law plus query noise. Sum log pairwise win probabilities and normalize as composite scores.
specification.risk: Linearization neglects quadratic prototype noise and composite pairwise scores need not be calibrated multiclass probabilities.

specification.title: Residual degrees-of-freedom noise
specification.hypothesis: Keep the class mean system, estimate residual degrees of freedom n-2 tr(S)+tr(S squared), S=sqrt(D) A inverse sqrt(D), with sixteen probes. Estimate class noise from whitened node-mean residuals with six pseudo-degrees at parent variance0.015, then propagate that variance through the mean estimator.
specification.risk: Weak class means contain mixture bias and finite trace estimates can distort degrees of freedom; this is not expert-label calibration.

specification.title: Sparse curvature fields
specification.hypothesis: Replace squared curvature by sum of Euclidean norms of L u in whitened RGB. Minimize weighted squared observations plus0.015 global anchoring and this convex sparse-curvature penalty using at most sixty ADMM steps with rho1; report primal,dual and stationarity residuals.
specification.risk: Finite ADMM may be slow or nonstationary, while sparse curvature can create artificial piecewise-affine appearance transitions.

specification.title: Positive log-variance transport
specification.hypothesis: Retain the bending mean; compute nonnegative coarse-weighted residual second moments in whitened RGB and shrink them0.8 toward data plus0.2 unit variance. Fit three log-variance bending fields and exponentiate their interpolants; use the resulting normalized diagonal Gaussian density.
specification.risk: Coarse mixtures inflate local variance and diagonal whitened covariance can miss rotating class-specific scatter.

specification.title: Morphology-guided prolongation
specification.hypothesis: Keep the parent bending solve but replace bilinear mean-field lifting by normalized four-corner bilinear weights multiplied by0.02+exp(-H&E optical-density difference squared/0.02). Score the unchanged RGB against those lifted means.
specification.risk: Nuclear edges may select an inappropriate neighbouring prototype and preserve noise rather than tissue boundaries.

specification.title: Convex tissue envelope
specification.hypothesis: Keep J01 tissue labels. Construct the convex hull of all non-white H&E pixels and remove only white pixels outside it; enclosed white areas are preserved. Use row extrema to build the same hull efficiently.
specification.risk: Deep true exterior clefts inside the convex hull remain filled and isolated stained specks can enlarge the envelope.

specification.title: Seeded barrier watershed
specification.hypothesis: Keep J01 tissue labels. On a four-coordinate-unit H&E grid seed white border pixels as glass and strongly stained pixels as tissue. Sort four-neighbour OD-contrast edges and construct the exact marker-constrained Kruskal minimum spanning forest; remove only original white pixels in glass trees.
specification.risk: Minimax contrast barriers and deterministic ties may assign a bright internal lumen to exterior glass; coarse sampling remains.

specification.title: Two independent escape routes
specification.hypothesis: Keep J01 tissue labels. On a four-coordinate-unit white grid join every border-white node to an exterior root. Tarjan biconnected decomposition identifies white nodes sharing a nontrivial block with that root, equivalent to two internally vertex-disjoint escape routes. Also remove white border nodes; gate the lifted result by original white pixels.
specification.risk: A genuine exterior cul-de-sac can be preserved while a broadly open fat cavity still has two escape routes.

specification.title: Categorical palette codebook
specification.hypothesis: Assume each pixel emits one supplied palette codeword and choose the exact least squared Euclidean RGB residual among eligible class codewords. Return its one-hot class score without mixture fitting or uncertain coarse correction.
specification.risk: Boundary RGB can be a genuine mixture and nearest codeword can systematically favor a visually intermediate class.

specification.title: Conditional channel proportions
specification.hypothesis: Normalize positive RGB channel sums and palette rows. Fit brightness-weighted mixture r by convex channel cross-entropy plus0.006 squared distance to the brightness-weighted coarse prior; recover tissue fractions q proportional to r divided by palette row brightness. Use at most180 projected-gradient steps and report residuals.
specification.risk: Constructed RGB bytes are not measured photon counts and brightness conditioning can remove real class information.

specification.title: Multiplicative palette mixture
specification.hypothesis: Transform occupied-node RGB averages and eligible palette rows by minus log((value+1/255)/(1+1/255)); solve the original quadratic simplex inverse in this optical-density geometry with the same coarse prior and confidence correction.
specification.risk: Converted RGB is artificial; multiplicative color mixing need not describe its forward construction, and node averaging remains approximate.

specification.title: Ordered appearance fields
specification.hypothesis: Jointly minimize the parent quadratic field energies subject to (mu_g-mu_h) dot (u_g-u_h) >=0.25||mu_g-mu_h||² at every field node in whitened RGB. ADMM uses Dykstra halfspace projections, at most80 outer and20 projection sweeps; report primal, dual and feasibility residuals.
specification.risk: The global coarse class ordering can be wrong locally; finite convex solves may miss tolerance and force real appearance crossings apart.

specification.title: Fractional spatial transport
specification.hypothesis: Replace the H&E-conducted local Laplacian by16 times the square root of the physical Neumann grid Laplacian, applied exactly on the finite cosine basis. Solve each screened class field by preconditioned CG, at most160 iterations, reporting the actual residual.
specification.risk: Nonlocal spatial borrowing ignores stain barriers and can spread a wrong class appearance across genuine anatomical interfaces.

specification.title: Adaptive stain components
specification.hypothesis: Partition the analysis H&E OD graph by sorted-edge union: merge regions only below min(internal_contrast_a+16/area_a,internal_contrast_b+16/area_b). Assign each entire region the parent geometric mean class evidence. No extra minimum-size merge or smoothing follows.
specification.risk: Stain components can represent nuclei rather than tissue compartments; a wrong region merge makes a whole architectural decision wrong.

specification.title: Uncertain nearest-appearance winner
specification.hypothesis: Retain parent means and positive sampling variance. Under independent local Gaussian prototype perturbations, estimate the probability that each class is nearest in whitened RGB with32 fixed antithetic Sobol draws; choose the largest joint winner frequency.
specification.risk: Finite winner cubature is coarse and assumed independent local prototype uncertainty need not represent the actual spatial posterior.

specification.title: Expected absolute colour error
specification.hypothesis: Retain parent appearance fits and sampling variance. Score minus the summed exact folded-normal expectations E|x_j-M_gj| in whitened RGB, with M_gj variance v_g. No log determinant or squared-distance risk is used.
specification.risk: Axiswise absolute loss depends on the chosen whitening axes and may favor a compact but wrong prototype.

specification.title: Gaussian affinity decision
specification.hypothesis: Retain parent means and positive sampling variance. Compare query N(x,I) with predictive N(mu,(1+v)I) using the closed-form Bhattacharyya affinity, including both determinant terms, instead of evaluating the query density.
specification.risk: A unit query covariance is an engineering model rather than calibrated optical noise, and affinity can tolerate an overly broad class.

specification.title: Full matrix covariance transport
specification.hypothesis: Retain bending mean fields. Build whitened residual second-moment SPD targets0.2I+0.8R, transport their symmetric matrix logarithms with the same screened field solve, exponentiate the full matrix at queries, and use its normalized Gaussian score.
specification.risk: Cross-channel moments from coarse labels may be unstable; six covariance fields and matrix exponentials can exceed the runtime budget.

specification.title: Derivative-based density decision
specification.hypothesis: Retain exactly the parent mean and log-variance fields. Replace log likelihood by minus the Gaussian Hyvarinen score0.5 sum(delta²/v²)-sum(1/v), taking derivatives in whitened colour with spatial field values fixed.
specification.risk: A proper density score does not guarantee an optimal classification rule and can strongly favor an overly precise class.

specification.title: Shared latent noise scale
specification.hypothesis: Retain bending means and residual moment targets. Fit log v_gj(s)=a(s)+b_gj by one joint screened quadratic system, with bending regularity on a and0.015 anchors on a and b. Use the normalized Gaussian score of these positive variances.
specification.risk: One shared noise surface can suppress genuine class-specific spatial variance and its factorization is not expert calibrated.

specification.title: Alpha-complex tissue envelope
specification.hypothesis: Infer native support from H&E alone: keep all non-white pixels and white pixels inside Delaunay triangles of a fixed8-coordinate-unit stained occupancy grid whose circumradius is at most64 units. Rasterize at native geometry; do not apply inherited common clipping.
specification.risk: Sparse sampled stain or folds can leave holes inside genuine tissue; alpha geometry can connect nearby unrelated tissue pieces.

specification.title: Probabilistic stain occupancy
specification.hypothesis: On a4-unit H&E occupancy grid estimate the stained fraction in a64-unit square window with Beta(0.5,0.5) prior. Keep non-white native pixels and white pixels where posterior P(stain_fraction>=0.05)>0.5. This support replaces common clipping.
specification.risk: Pale tissue can have too little stain and nearby tissue can falsely support exterior glass; occupancy samples are spatially correlated.

specification.title: Diffusive glass residence
specification.hypothesis: On a4-unit white grid solve minus discrete Laplacian(t)=1 with absorbing border-white seeds and reflecting stained boundaries. Remove only original native-white pixels with finite mean exterior escape time<=32² coordinate units squared; all other pixels retain tissue labels.
specification.risk: Open fat can have a short escape time and broad exterior glass can have a long one; local photometry cannot establish tissue identity.

specification.title: Spatially coupled mixture field
specification.hypothesis: Jointly minimize dense palette squared error+0.006 prior deviation+0.02 H&E-edge-weighted vector total variation of fractions, with simplex constraints. Use120 primal-dual steps and report feasibility and fixed-point residuals before the same weak coarse correction as the parent; do not smooth saved labels.
specification.risk: Joint fraction regularity can erase small glands; the finite solve and dense multiclass arrays can be slow.

specification.title: Log-ratio palette observation
specification.hypothesis: Fit simplex fractions at occupied colour nodes by half squared centred-log-ratio error between RGB+1/255 and the positive palette mixture, plus0.006 prior deviation. Use180 projected backtracking steps and report projected stationarity.
specification.risk: Discarding overall brightness may discard real class information; the nonlinear observation objective can have local stationary points.

specification.title: Negative-class tail competition
specification.hypothesis: Retain the parent palette probabilities. For each class estimate its weighted upper-tail probability under other known coarse classes, using a half-count correction, then choose the smallest null-tail probability; use parent fractions only as deterministic ties.
specification.risk: Contaminated coarse negatives can distort the tails and no expert false-discovery calibration is available.

specification.title: Illumination-calibrated glass
specification.hypothesis: Estimate an affine RGB blank plane from bright neutral border samples by Huber regression. Replace the fixed white predicate by a three-channel standardized blank residual (squared distance<=16, channel range<=24); retain exactly the parent Beta-binomial occupancy decision on this stain definition.
specification.risk: The border may contain tissue rather than glass, and a blank illumination plane can misclassify pale tissue. An insufficient border sample triggers the explicitly reported original photometric predicate.

specification.title: Local stain enclosure depth
specification.hypothesis: On a4 micrometre grid compute the stained fraction in each of eight oriented half-disks of radius64 micrometres. Keep every nonwhite pixel and white pixels whose minimum oriented half-disk stained fraction exceeds0.025; lift the scalar depth bilinearly to native pixels.
specification.risk: Open adipose edges lack surrounding stain and may be cut; scattered debris can falsely enclose glass. Eight orientations only approximate continuous halfspace depth.

specification.title: Texture-versus-blank evidence
specification.hypothesis: Estimate blank noise variance from adjacent neutral border RGB differences on a4 micrometre grid. In each64 micrometre square compare an isotropic blank covariance against a rank-one texture covariance. Keep white where n/2*(r-1-log(r)) >1.5log(n), r=max(1,lambda_max/noise), and retain all nonwhite. Strength and two directions give three extra parameters with globally fixed blank noise.
specification.risk: Spatial correlation makes the nominal patch sample size optimistic. Scanner texture and compression can look like tissue; unstained fat may have insufficient texture.

specification.title: Wasserstein scale transport
specification.hypothesis: Keep the parent bending means and residual variance targets. Transport their positive standard deviations, using a screened first-order M-matrix and a unit prior, then square the lifted field for normalized diagonal Gaussian likelihood.
specification.risk: A different variance geometry can overbroaden classes. The variance transport uses a positive first-order operator because the bending inverse does not obey a maximum principle.

specification.title: Asymmetric residual appearance
specification.hypothesis: Keep parent bending means. Fit separate positive/negative residual second-moment targets for each whitened channel, transport their logarithms with the same bending solve, and use the normalized two-piece normal score -sum(log(s_plus+s_minus)+delta²/(2*s_sign²)).
specification.risk: Small coarse classes may poorly estimate one residual side; a two-piece normal is a model of synthetic RGB rather than a biological measurement.

specification.title: Conditional residual innovations
specification.hypothesis: Keep parent bending mean and log-variance fields. Standardize residuals, estimate each class/channel four-neighbour autoregression rho in[-0.8,0.8] by original coarse weighted least squares with0.015 ridge, and score normalized Gaussian innovations z-rho*neighbour_mean(z), including fitted innovation variance and the original variance determinant.
specification.risk: Conditional scores are a pseudolikelihood, not a normalized joint image distribution. Coarse contamination and wrong neighbours can reward an incorrect class.

specification.title: Credible-ball appearance risk
specification.hypothesis: Keep exactly the parent whitened means and positive sampling variance. Choose the class minimizing (norm(x-mu)+sqrt(7.814727903*v))², the worst distance over its95 percent three-dimensional Gaussian prototype credible ball.
specification.risk: A conservative uncertainty penalty can remove a correctly rare class. The sampling variance is not expert calibrated and the nominal95 percent level is only a model statement.

specification.title: Tolerance-ball prototype probability
specification.hypothesis: Keep parent means and sampling variance. Score the analytic probability that a Gaussian prototype lies within a unit-radius ball of the query in whitened RGB; use parent predictive density only to break finite-precision ties.
specification.risk: A unit whitened tolerance is an engineering decision. Tiny prototype variance can saturate probabilities and make tie decisions important.

specification.title: Residual sandwich uncertainty
specification.hypothesis: Keep the parent H&E-conducted means. Propagate16 fixed Rademacher probes multiplied by per-node, per-channel fitted residuals through each screened field system. Their positive outer-product average, scaled0.015, is a full3x3 sampling covariance; score N(mu,I+V).
specification.risk: Residuals aggregated at field nodes underestimate within-node variation. The16-probe sandwich is an approximation and may be costly for many classes.

specification.title: Stain-contour advection
specification.hypothesis: Replace the symmetric parent transport operator by its sum with an upwind directed graph generated by the rotated spatial gradient of H&E optical density. Solve the resulting screened M-matrix for each class; report equation residuals and constant reproduction.
specification.risk: Contour circulation can transport appearance along an irrelevant microscopic stain contour. Directed transport is not an anatomical flow measurement.

specification.title: Shared skew colour field
specification.hypothesis: Fit one shared three-component field omega(s) under the observation x=mu_g+omega(s) cross (mu_g-barycentre), with the parent H&E Laplacian and0.015 zero anchor. Solve one joint sparse quadratic normal system; compare queries against these locally coupled prototypes.
specification.risk: A skew linear sensor field cannot express all local changes and large rotations are only a first-order approximation. Degenerate class colours leave some directions prior-determined.

specification.title: Fuzzy tissue connectivity
specification.hypothesis: On a4 micrometre grid take parent class probabilities as gray ceilings. Seed each class at original coarse interior observations whose continuous weight exceeds0.8. Compute the exact maximum over paths of the minimum ceiling/seed value, separately per class, using C++ priority queues; normalize and lift these connectivity evidences.
specification.risk: A small true island without a coarse seed can disappear; a weak bridge can still connect a false region. This is a seeded connectivity model, not discovery of an absent class.

specification.title: Tile-integral plurality projection
specification.hypothesis: Keep parent palette probabilities. On a4 micrometre quadrature grid minimize mean KL(q||p)+sum_tiles sum_rivals max(mean(q_rival-q_observed),0)². Solve the nonnegative smooth dual by L-BFGS-B, at most100 iterations; lift each tile logit offset without freezing any pixel and report projected dual residual.
specification.risk: An incorrect coarse winner can be reinforced and quadrature only approximates full-pixel tile integrals. The bounded optimizer may fail stationarity or exceed one second.

specification.title: Censored channel inverse
specification.hypothesis: At occupied colour nodes minimize the fixed palette squared error for interior channels and sigma² times negative Gaussian log-tail probability for RGB channels within one byte of0/255, with sigma0.05 and the parent0.006 prior ridge. Use projected gradient on the simplex, at most160 steps, and report projected stationarity.
specification.risk: The converted RGB may not arise from a censored Gaussian sensor. A finite optimizer can miss tolerance, and changing the observation model can spoil a useful exact linear mixture.

specification.title: Bayesian contiguous regions
specification.hypothesis: On a4 micrometre grid sum log parent palette probabilities per cell. A region has log evidence logsumexp(class log scores)-log(K). Repeatedly merge adjacent regions with the largest positive log Bayes factor for a shared class, update neighbours, and label by its pooled posterior. C++ implements the deterministic greedy graph operation.
specification.risk: Correlated probability cells overstate evidence and a greedy merge is not a globally optimal partition. Narrow channels can merge away and weak evidence can promote excessive pooling.

interpretation: Descriptive index of registered code and stated hypotheses. It does not certify mathematical novelty, successful execution, convergence, biological validity, full-benchmark evaluation, or cycle completion. Compare equations and risks, not just names. Controls are outside the20 selectable candidates.
